english: Let $P$ be the product of the first $10$ terms of the geometric progression $6,\ 3,\ \dfrac32,\ \dfrac34,\ \ldots$. It is given that $\log_{10}2=0.3010$ and $\log_{10}3=0.4771$. Then the mantissa of $\log_{10}P$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $P$ गुणोत्तर श्रेढ़ी $6,\ 3,\ \dfrac32,\ \dfrac34,\ \ldots$ के प्रथम $10$ पदों का गुणनफल है। दिया है कि $\log_{10}2=0.3010$ तथा $\log_{10}3=0.4771$ है। तब $\log_{10}P$ का अपूर्णांश (mantissa) ______ है।
solution: Mantissa must lie in $[0,1)$: $-5.764=-6+0.236$, so characteristic $-6$, mantissa $0.236\approx0.24$
solution_full: The progression has first term $a=6$ and common ratio $r=\dfrac12$, so the $k$-th term is $6\left(\dfrac12\right)^{k-1}$.
The characteristic is the greatest integer not exceeding $\log_{10}P$, and the mantissa is the non-negative part: $-5.7640=-6+0.2360$.
So the characteristic is $-6$ and the mantissa is $0.2360$, which is $0.24$ to two decimal places (the exact value $0.2352\ldots$ gives the same rounding).
(Taking $0.764$ as the mantissa is the usual mistake.)
originality_note: New: the mantissa of the logarithm of a product of GP terms that is a small number (3^10/2^35), so the negative-log mantissa convention is needed (way 5). Closest known: number of digits of 2^n or 3^n, and the product formula a^n r^{n(n-1)/2}. Different because: the GP product must be simplified to prime powers and the log is negative, so characteristic and mantissa must be separated correctly.
